home_subtitle: Knitting that inspires. Knowledge that guides step by step.
home_youtube_desc: On our channel we show knitting as it really is — without rushing or shortcuts. We explain patterns, analyze symbols and share techniques that help avoid mistakes and gain confidence with needles.
home_app_desc: An educational tool for working with knitting patterns. Analyzes designs, explains symbols and supports learning step by step.
home_books_desc: Original knitting books — reading patterns, understanding symbols, pattern construction. Reliable knowledge to return to again and again.
home_why_intro: Because we believe knitting is more than a hobby. It's a skill you can develop consciously, calmly and with satisfaction.
home_why_outro:
Welcome to a world where patterns stop being a mystery,
and knitting becomes a true pleasure.
apps_p1: The app was created for people who want to better understand knitting patterns and work with them in a more conscious, calm and organised way.
apps_p3: It is aimed at both beginners learning to read patterns and more advanced users who want to analyse designs faster and with greater confidence.
apps_p5: The app does not replace traditional knowledge or experience — it complements them, organising information and supporting the user during work with patterns.
apps_p6: The project is developed in the spirit of modern education — with respect for the craft and openness to technologies that support the learning process.
apps_feat1_desc: Understand knitting patterns and designs step by step, without guessing.
apps_feat2_desc: Translates abbreviations and symbols from various sources and traditions.
apps_feat3_desc: Learning without pressure — at your own pace, with clear guidance.
apps_feat4_desc: For beginner and advanced knitters alike.
books_desc: Original knitting publications — reliable knowledge for every level.
patterns_desc: Stitch patterns and charts for your knitting projects.
contact_desc: Write to us — we reply to every question.
video_desc: Here you can watch YouTube videos.
shorts_desc: Quick tips and practical tricks in short videos.
home_intro_p1: Para Drutów is a space created out of passion for knitting, learning and sharing knowledge. It's a place for everyone who wants not only to knit beautiful things, but above all to understand the patterns, charts and techniques behind them.
home_intro_p2: We combine traditional craft with a modern approach to education — calmly, carefully and with respect for every stage of learning.
home_youtube_for: It's a channel for both beginners and advanced knitters who want to:
home_youtube_li1: learn to read patterns step by step
home_youtube_li2: understand the logic of stitch designs
home_youtube_li3: develop skills consciously and without frustration
home_app_goal: StitchAI's goal is not to replace knitting knowledge, but to organise it and support the learning process — so that working with patterns becomes calmer, more intuitive and simply more enjoyable.
home_books_li4: a practical approach to learning knitting
home_books_note: Our publications are created for people who want a reliable source of knowledge they can return to repeatedly — regardless of their skill level.
apps_p2: In the world of knitting, charts are a universal language — but their interpretation can be difficult, especially when they come from different sources, cultures or technical publications.
apps_p4: Particular emphasis has been placed on clarity of information and a clear way of presenting explanations. Instead of complex descriptions, users receive logical, readable explanations.
apps_p7: An additional goal of the app is to build confidence with patterns by better understanding their structure.
apps_p8: The app grows gradually, with plans to expand functionality and add new types of patterns. It is a tool built for long-term user support.
